entries.en: The scan revealed a narrowing of the arteria coronaria.
entries.zh: 扫描显示冠状动脉有一处狭窄。

entries.en: The illustration traced the arteria cystica toward the gallbladder.
entries.zh: 插图描出了胆囊动脉通向胆囊的走向。

entries.en: A red line represented the arteria facialis on the model.
entries.zh: 模型上的一条红线代表面动脉。

entries.en: The diagram placed the arteria femoralis in the thigh.
entries.zh: 示意图把股动脉标在大腿部位。

entries.en: The atlas followed the arteria gastrica along the stomach wall.
entries.zh: 图谱沿胃壁描绘了胃动脉。

entries.en: The report described blood flow through the arteria hepatica.
entries.zh: 报告描述了流经肝动脉的血流。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing showed branches of the arteria ileocolica.
entries.zh: 解剖图显示了回结肠动脉的分支。

entries.en: The surgeon identified the arteria iliaca on the image.
entries.zh: 外科医生在影像上辨认出了髂动脉。

entries.en: The student highlighted the arteria iliolumbalis in the pelvic diagram.
entries.zh: 学生在骨盆示意图中突出标出了髂腰动脉。

entries.en: The facial model included the arteria infraorbitalis below the eye socket.
entries.zh: 面部模型包括了眼眶下方的眶下动脉。

entries.en: The magnified illustration made the arteria lacrimalis clearly visible.
entries.zh: 放大的插图让泪腺动脉清晰可见。

entries.en: The scan traced the arteria lienalis toward the spleen.
entries.zh: 扫描描出了脾动脉通向脾脏的走向。

entries.en: The drawing marked the arteria lingualis beneath the tongue.
entries.zh: 图画在舌头下方标出了舌动脉。

entries.en: The specialist compared images of the arteria maxillaris.
entries.zh: 专科医生比较了上颌动脉的影像。

entries.en: The model showed the arteria mesenterica approaching the intestines.
entries.zh: 模型显示肠系膜动脉通向肠道。

entries.en: The foot diagram identified an arteria metatarsea in red.
entries.zh: 足部示意图用红色标出了一条跖动脉。

entries.en: The section showed the arteria nutricia entering the long bone.
entries.zh: 切面显示滋养动脉进入长骨。

entries.en: The lecturer pointed to the arteria ophthalmica beside the eye.
entries.zh: 讲师指向眼睛旁的眼动脉。

entries.en: The illustration followed the arteria ovarica toward the ovary.
entries.zh: 插图描出了卵巢动脉通向卵巢的走向。

entries.en: The atlas marked several branches near the arteria perinealis.
entries.zh: 图谱在会阴动脉附近标出了几条分支。

entries.en: The diagram distinguished the arteria pulmonalis from nearby veins.
entries.zh: 示意图把肺动脉与附近的静脉区分开来。

entries.en: The image followed the arteria radialis toward the wrist.
entries.zh: 影像描出了桡动脉向手腕延伸的走向。

entries.en: The scan showed the arteria renalis entering the kidney.
entries.zh: 扫描显示肾动脉进入肾脏。

entries.en: The anatomical plate traced the course of the arteria testicularis.
entries.zh: 解剖图版描绘了睾丸动脉的走行。

entries.en: The student located the arteria ulnaris in the forearm drawing.
entries.zh: 学生在前臂图中找到了尺动脉。

entries.en: The model displayed the arteria uterina alongside the uterus.
entries.zh: 模型在子宫旁显示了子宫动脉。

entries.en: The pelvic illustration labeled the arteria vaginalis separately.
entries.zh: 骨盆插图单独标注了阴道动脉。

entries.en: The scan allowed a clearer view of the arteria vertebralis.
entries.zh: 扫描让椎动脉显示得更加清楚。

entries.en: The report included arterial blood gases measured that morning.
entries.zh: 报告包括了当天早晨测定的动脉血气。

entries.en: Water rose from the artesian well without pumping.
entries.zh: 水不经抽取就从自流井中涌出。

entries.en: The dissection exposed an articular muscle beside the joint capsule.
entries.zh: 解剖显露了关节囊旁的一块关节肌。

entries.en: The model showed movement at the articulatio coxae.
entries.zh: 模型展示了髋关节的运动。

entries.en: The diagram compared the articulatio cubiti in two positions.
entries.zh: 示意图比较了肘关节的两种位置。

entries.en: The image showed swelling around the articulatio genus.
entries.zh: 影像显示膝关节周围有肿胀。

entries.en: The anatomy model allowed rotation at the articulatio humeri.
entries.zh: 解剖模型可以在肩关节处转动。

entries.en: The drawing outlined the articulatio radiocarpea near the hand.
entries.zh: 图画勾勒出了靠近手部的桡腕关节。

entries.en: The scan revealed an injury near the articulatio talocruralis.
entries.zh: 扫描显示踝关节附近有一处损伤。

entries.en: The model demonstrated rotation within an articulatio trochoidea.
entries.zh: 模型演示了车轴关节内的旋转运动。

entries.en: The medical record identified the implanted artificial pacemaker.
entries.zh: 病历注明了植入的人工心脏起搏器。

entries.en: The image showed the arytenoid cartilage behind the vocal folds.
entries.zh: 影像显示了声带后方的杓状软骨。

entries.en: The school closed during asbestos abatement.
entries.zh: 学校在清除石棉期间关闭。

entries.en: The radiologist examined the ascending aorta on the scan.
entries.zh: 放射科医生检查了扫描影像上的升主动脉。

entries.en: The diagram traced the ascending artery toward the ascending colon.
entries.zh: 示意图描出了升动脉通向升结肠的走向。

entries.en: The illustration colored the ascending colon in blue.
entries.zh: 插图把升结肠涂成了蓝色。

entries.en: The orbit crossed the ecliptic plane at its ascending node.
entries.zh: 轨道在升交点处穿过黄道面。

entries.en: The discharge summary listed aspiration pneumonia among the diagnoses.
entries.zh: 出院小结把吸入性肺炎列为诊断之一。

entries.en: During assertiveness training, participants practiced stating their needs directly.
entries.zh: 在自信心确立训练中，参与者练习直接表达自己的需求。

entries.en: The assistant foreman assigned our afternoon tasks.
entries.zh: 助理工长分派了我们下午的任务。

entries.en: The instrument contained carefully balanced astatic coils.
entries.zh: 仪器装有经过仔细平衡的无定向线圈。

entries.en: The old clinical description classified him as an asthenic type.
entries.zh: 旧临床描述将他归为无力体型。

entries.en: The neurologist documented ataxic abasia in the examination notes.
entries.zh: 神经科医生在检查记录中记载了共济失调性步行不能。

entries.en: He packed an athletic supporter with his sports equipment.
entries.zh: 他把护裆和运动器材一起装好。

entries.en: The museum displayed a model of an early atom smasher.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一台早期粒子加速器的模型。

entries.en: The exhibition included an inert model of an atomic warhead.
entries.zh: 展览包括了一个不具爆炸能力的核弹头模型。

entries.en: The study recorded a family history of atopic allergy.
entries.zh: 研究记录了特应性变态反应的家族史。

entries.en: The monitor recorded an episode of atrial fibrillation.
entries.zh: 监测仪记录了一次心房纤维性颤动发作。

entries.en: The diagram showed the opening associated with an atrial septal defect.
entries.zh: 示意图显示了房间隔缺损所涉及的开口。

entries.en: The heart model marked the atrioventricular node with a dot.
entries.zh: 心脏模型用一个圆点标出了房室结。

entries.en: She placed the signed papers inside her attache case.
entries.zh: 她把签好的文件放进公文包。

entries.en: Our editor stays au courant with developments in local theater.
entries.zh: 我们的编辑一直了解当地戏剧界的最新动态。

entries.en: The kitchen served cauliflower au gratin with browned breadcrumbs.
entries.zh: 厨房端上了覆有烤成褐色面包屑的菜花。

entries.en: The restaurant served the roast beef au jus.
entries.zh: 餐厅端上了带原汁的烤牛肉。

entries.en: The audio amplifier boosted the quiet recording.
entries.zh: 音频放大器放大了那段音量很低的录音。

entries.en: The archive preserved an audio recording of the interview.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存了访谈的一份录音。

entries.en: The report described auditory aphasia despite normal hearing.
entries.zh: 报告描述了听力正常情况下的听觉性失语。

entries.en: The exhibit showed the entire auditory apparatus in cross section.
entries.zh: 展品用剖面展示了整个听觉器官。

entries.en: The illustration followed the auditory canal toward the eardrum.
entries.zh: 插图描出了外耳道通向鼓膜的走向。

entries.en: The experiment measured activity in the auditory cortex.
entries.zh: 实验测量了听觉皮层的活动。

entries.en: The enlarged model showed an auditory ossicle beside the eardrum.
entries.zh: 放大的模型显示了鼓膜旁的一块听小骨。

entries.en: The participant reported an auditory sensation during the test.
entries.zh: 参与者报告在测试期间产生了听觉感受。
